The sample corruption job writes status zero. The AdventureWorks consumer contract accepts only the five statuses generated by this subset.

A currency without its ISO name cannot be rendered by the invoicing consumer, which refuses to print a bare code. The name is not arbitrary: it is the reviewed ISO vocabulary in datasets/currencies.yaml, looked up by the row's own code. A code the vocabulary does not know (the seeded ZZZ row) is left unpatched and listed at the gate — inventing a name for an unknown code is exactly what this pipeline refuses to do.
